_comment: The sample demo made with demo-studio. Shots name raw takes in recordings/raw; in/out are seconds of the raw take; speed > 1 speeds it up.
title: Todo app sample

brand.name: Todo sample
spelling: TodoMVC: one word, capitals T, M, V, C
taglines: A todo list in three moves.

card-open.title: A todo list in three moves
card-open.subtitle: Add. Tick off. Clear.

ADD.screen: Three todos are typed, each one lands in the list on Enter; the counter reads 3 items left

TICK.screen: Two todos are ticked off; Active shows the one left, Completed shows the two done, then back to All
TICK.text: Tick things off. Filter what is left.

CLEAR.screen: Clear completed removes the two finished todos; one is left

videos.label: the whole app in under thirty seconds
videos.title: TODO APP SAMPLE: PROMO

scenes.name: Add
scenes.voiceover: A todo list should take seconds. Type what needs doing and press Enter.

scenes.name: Tick off
scenes.voiceover: Tick things off as you finish them. Filters show what is still active and what is done.

scenes.name: Clear
scenes.voiceover: Clear the finished ones in one click.

scenes.name: Close
scenes.voiceover: A real app, with real clicks.

brief.summary: A thirty second sample that shows what demo-studio produces. The app on screen is the public TodoMVC React example, filmed as it runs.
edit_notes: The app sits in the top centre of the frame. Zoom to about 1.7x on it for the whole video.
fixes: The site's side panel about the framework was hidden while recording; it is not part of the app.
do_not_say: Do not call it our product. It is a public sample app.
claims: Todos are added with Enter (scene Add)
Filters show active and completed todos (scene Tick off)
Clear completed removes finished todos in one click (scene Clear)
